_doc: SAMPLE-AUDIT-1: sampling rate for the System 3* audit of merged PRs, read by foundation/sampleaudit.py. Protected-path PRs are always audited. The rate starts at base, multiplies by step_up for each defect among the last `window` verdicts, and stays between floor and ceiling. Starting values are a first guess, not a measured optimum; the verdicts this loop records are what to tune them from. max_open caps unaudited Q-AUDIT items so a slow reviewer cannot be buried; max_per_day caps new ones per pass, protected-path PRs first.
